cfg.h.external_ci.enabled: Reads Buildbot, GitLab CI, Jenkins and Azure Pipelines for mirrored repositories. Only GET requests; nothing is written to them. Off by default.
cfg.h.external_ci.sources: One line per source: kind;repo=NAME;url=URL and project= (gitlab, azure), job= (jenkins), builders=a+b (buildbot), branch=, token_env=NAME OF AN ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE (never the secret itself).
cfg.h.external_ci.refresh_seconds: Never less than 300. A source that fails repeatedly is asked less often.
cfg.h.external_ci.timeout_s: A service that takes longer is marked degraded, never red.
cfg.h.external_ci.max_bytes: A longer answer is cut off and the source is degraded.
cfg.h.external_ci.allow_private_targets: Off: addresses of this computer, of the local network and of cloud metadata are refused. Turn on only for a server of your own network.
cfg.h.external_ci.experimental: Jenkins and Azure Pipelines have only been tested against fake servers.
cfg.h.external_ci.breaker.failures: After this many failures in a row the source is marked degraded and asked less often.
cfg.h.external_ci.buildbot.max_builders: Only the builders named in builders= when the source names them.
cfg.h.external_ci.gitlab.max_pipelines: Most recent pipelines read per project.
cfg.h.external_ci.jenkins.enabled: Lines of kind jenkins are only read with this on. token_env holds user:token.
cfg.h.external_ci.azure.enabled: Lines of kind azure are only read with this on. url is that of the organization.
cfg.f.external_ci.alert.enabled: Alert on a failed external build
cfg.h.external_ci.alert.enabled: The red of an external source counts like a red of Actions and can be silenced.
cfg.h.external_ci.alert.level: error (like a red of Actions) or warning.
cfg.f.external_ci.logs.enabled: Fetch the end of failed logs
cfg.h.external_ci.logs.enabled: Off by default. Only the tail, redacted, without terminal sequences, kept in memory and never given to an AI as an instruction.
cfg.h.external_ci.logs.max_kb: Most kilobytes kept of one log.
cfg.h.external_ci.logs.tail_lines: Most lines kept of one log.
cfg.h.external_ci.logs.keep_hours: After this it is forgotten (it is only kept in memory).
egress.use.extci: The external CI sources you configured (read only).
egress.fail.extci: If blocked: those sources show as degraded; their builds are not seen.
ui.extci.title: External CI sources
ui.extci.off: Reading of external sources is off.
ui.extci.log_none: No log is kept for that build.
ui.extci.test_label: Try a source line without saving it
ui.extci.alert_degraded: External source {source} of {repo} cannot be read: {reason}
cli.extci.help: External CI sources, read only: list, status, probe --source LINE.
cli.extci.help_source: The source line to try (external-ci probe).
cli.extci.none: No external CI source is configured.
cfg.f.sources.multi_owner: Accounts of more than one owner
cfg.h.sources.multi_owner: Lets one installation register accounts of different owners. The identity of every repository (source, owner, name) is always kept.
ui.cfg_err_extci_owner: another account of this installation belongs to a different owner (turn on sources.multi_owner)
cli.extci.help_identity: repository identity: show, plan (changes nothing) or apply the migration of the saved data
cli.extci.identity_owner: Owner of the saved data: {was}; owner watched: {owner}
doctor.f.extci: A source cannot be read or its line is not understood: run the command below.
doctor.f.extci_identity: Accounts of several owners need sources.multi_owner, or the saved data belongs to another owner: look at the plan.
